zara: FYI kicking off a short owners sweep focused on KMS grants and admin roles in prod. sampling only. goal: tag ownerless KMS bindings and start owner outreach tomorrow morning
rick: scope? prod only or prod+canary? also watch audit ingestion—we had spikes last week
auditbot: auditbot: ingest_median=4m; ingest_99p=22m; retention_key_admin=400d; last_key_acl=4391230000
emily: if ingest_99p > 30m we should pause. also propose `leastpriv-exempt` TTL=24h for expected infra churn
rick: SQL to find ownerless key grants (example):
```
SELECT key_id, principal, granted_at FROM kms_grants WHERE owner IS NULL AND granted_at > now() - interval '180 days';
```
zara: thanks. we'll run dry-run Wed 08:30, emit CSV, and open tickets for owners. emily can you update runbook with rollback: restore from /infra/backups/{key}_iam.json
emily: on it. please cc eng-sre when the dry-run completes
zara: will do. will post CSVs here and tag @auditbot for latency check before final run
